title: Last night something happened at the cruiseship
content: All I remember is that I was meant to go to the kitchen, but got lost in the mirror hallway, when I turned around and someone was there rounding people up taking us outside in rows. I asked arround what was going on, but people where talking like they were waiting to get into a venue, I was aware we weren't at the stadium but at the cruiseship, they seemed to try to "relocate" me to wherever they were talking about. A familiar face came to talk to me (as to again relocate me outside of the cruiseship) and I ran away, found the back stairs and then aa guard looking guy grabed me...and I woke up. Aren't we supposed to be aware we are in mallworld? I don't understand. Btw. English not my first language so sorry if you can't understand me.
